mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% year-over-year signals inflationary pressures that typically lead to tighter monetary policy, which in turn increases borrowing costs and reduces corporate earnings, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If CPIAUCSL YoY > 2% and S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances, or if Rank IC for this signal remains below 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in Real Final Sales (RSAFS) over two consecutive months indicates weakening consumer demand, which leads to reduced corporate revenues and earnings, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If RSAFS declines for 2 consecutive months and S&P 500 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances, or if Rank IC for this signal remains below 0.04 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5 percentage points in one month signals labor market distress, which typically precedes broader economic weakness and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE rises > 0.5pp in 1 month and S&P 500 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances, or if Rank IC for this signal remains below 0.05 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A significant drop in Industrial Production (INDPRO) by more than 1% month-over-month signals supply-side disruptions, which can lead to reduced corporate output and earnings, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If INDPRO drops > 1% MoM and S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances, or if Rank IC for this signal remains below 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: An always-on signal where a high level of housing starts (HOUST) indicates strong consumer demand and economic growth, which supports positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If HOUST levels are high and S&P 500 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 45% of instances, or if Rank IC for this signal remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: An interaction-driven signal where a combination of rising unemployment (UNRATE) and falling nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) indicates broad labor market weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE rises and PAYEMS falls concurrently and S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances, or if Rank IC for this interaction remains below 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A regime-conditional signal where during a monetary tightening cycle, a rise in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) by more than 0.25% in a month signals increased borrowing costs, which reduces corporate earnings and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS rises > 0.25% in 1 month during a tightening cycle and S&P 500 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances, or if Rank IC for this signal remains below 0.05 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: An interaction-driven signal where a combination of declining real GDP (GDPC1) and falling real final sales (RSAFS) indicates a broad-based economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If GDPC1 and RSAFS both decline concurrently and S&P 500 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances, or if Rank IC for this interaction remains below 0.04 over any 3-year rolling window.
